name: Tomato
description: The base of half the world's gravies and salads.

histamine.note: One of the biggest everyday histamine offenders.

nutrition.highlight: cooking makes the lycopene more available, not less

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.

effects.note: An 8-week trial had postmenopausal women eat a fresh beefsteak tomato before bed and found a tenfold rise in a urinary melatonin marker alongside a measurable improvement in sleep quality scores — beefsteak varieties carry more melatonin than other tomato forms, and the trial used the fruit raw. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
